name: BSP_FrontEndFrame_SelectLayoutSet
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x164 singleton at 00E18D80, two stack arguments (int set, char commit), RET 8 inferred from the call site at 004c9b85 (no caller-side ADD ESP), not read from the epilogue. Holds three parallel handle arrays with matching .rdata name tables: backdrop this+0Ch / names 00E08500 / 13 slots / set stride 34h; panel this+110h / names 00E08604 / 2 slots / set stride 8; title this+138h / names 00E0862C / 2 slots / set stride 8. Returns at once when set equals this+160h. With commit set it first walks all three arrays slot-major and releases every handle belonging to another set (BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa31f0 when the word at layout+4h is exactly 1, otherwise InterlockedDecrement(layout+4h) with the layout virtual +0h at zero), then fills the requested set's null slots with BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa5840(&name, 1, 1), then stores this+160h = set. Tables: set 0 and 1 FE_frame + FE_frame_title, set 2 adds FE_options_bg (backdrop 6) and FE_main (backdrop 12), set 3 GUI_pause + GUI_pause_title, set 4 empty. GGame::OnInitTitle calls it with (0, 1), so the title bring-up loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title through this path. Four callers: 004c9a70, 004c9ca0, 004dfb70, BSP_LoadingScreen_Begin. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md | Run-time evidence from bsp_game.exe milestone 2c (packet cc_exe_2c), `--frames 120 --press-start-frame 30` against the installed game; see docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md. Set 0 loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title; both stay on screen through the press-start handover because they belong to the 0x164 layout singleton and not to a registry screen.

name: BSP_BriefingScreen_Enter
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this), RET, SEH frame; 589 decompiled lines, body 0051CDE0-0051DCD6. Slot +18h of vtable 00CEC948. Calls 00518DA0, shows the FE_briefing_grid page at +14h, clears +54h, pushes the string BRIEFING through 005189B0 and reads the key at +0D8h through 0051CC90 into +28h. name: BSP_BriefingScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this) returning this, SEH frame, RET. The 138h screen at 00E198AC+64h. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct (004F7180), installs primary vtable 00CEC948 at +00h and 00CEC934 at +08h, 00CEC914 at +0Ch, zeroes the field runs up to +11Ch, then allocates a node through 0051ACB0 into +130h and self-links it (+0h, +4h and +8h all point at the node, byte 1 at +19h) before clearing +134h. Slot +00h of 00CEC948 is 0051E250, a 'mov eax,3; ret' leaf, so the screen id is 3 = INTF_BRIEFING. Register override 0051E280 binds FE_briefing_grid and FE_briefing_listbox.
